desc: Ideation: reduce query to max dp[i] over i<=R, A_i<=X
Implement dp computation with compressed-value Fenwick max (strict: query c-1)

Validate edge cases: all equal values (dp all 1, answer 1), increasing/decreasing arrays, R=1, X equal to minimum, duplicates at threshold (inclusive activation, strict dp chaining)
